p.src: 1  I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.

en: I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.
u.src: 1  I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.

en: 138:1 The word elohim, used here, usually means “God” but can also mean “gods”, “princes”, or “angels”.

p.src: 2  I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.

en: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.
u.src: 2  I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.

p.src: 3  In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.

en: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.
u.src: 3  In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.

p.src: 4  All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, LORD, for they have heard the words of your mouth.

en: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, LORD, for they have heard the words of your mouth.
u.src: 4  All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, LORD, for they have heard the words of your mouth.

p.src: 5  Yes, they will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the LORD’s glory is great!

en: Yes, they will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the LORD’s glory is great!
u.src: 5  Yes, they will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the LORD’s glory is great!

p.src: 6  For though the LORD is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.

en: For though the LORD is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.
u.src: 6  For though the LORD is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.

p.src: 7  Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.

en: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.
u.src: 7  Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.

p.src: 8  The LORD will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, LORD, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.

en: The LORD will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, LORD, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.
u.src: 8  The LORD will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, LORD, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.
